answer: A prism is one clone. bridge is the single journal anchoring operator, work root and streak, so shared histories merge instead of multiplying. Judges mint one soulbound summit per accepted epoch; influence is streak squared, and the kth live prism must keep a streak longer than k or its weight goes negative. Faking n heavy heads needs streaks 1..n, about n(n+1)/2 judged epochs, serialized by one badge per epoch. It fails if summit is sold, streaks merge, or bridge misses duplicates.
